title: 한국어 공부법 안내 읽기: 어떻게 공부하고, 어떻게 물어봐요?
objective: You can read a Korean study-tips guide or club notice and find the method, time and preparation. You can also ask for corrections and reply politely to praise.
summary: Read a Korean study-tips guide, learn common study methods, and practise asking for corrections and answering compliments.
note: Korean language centres and study groups often hand out study-tips sheets like this one.

task.title: Read, match and choose
task.line: Read each item. Then write the study method or answer, or fill in the blank. Use the study methods list for items 1 and 5, the notice in the question for item 2, and the Language sense box for items 3 and 4.

sections.heading: Study methods in a Korean guide

items.text: You listen and repeat right after the speaker, copying speed and tone.
items.example: 뉴스를 들으면서 바로 따라 말해 보세요.

items.text: You write down exactly what you hear.
You read a text out loud instead of silently.
items.example: 교과서를 소리 내어 읽으면 발음이 좋아져요.

items.text: A notebook or app where you collect new words.
items.example: 새 단어는 단어장에 예문과 함께 적어요.

items.text: You memorize a whole phrase at once, not word by word.
items.example: ‘잘 부탁드립니다’는 한 번에 외우는 게 좋아요.

items.text: Two people teach each other their own languages.
items.example: 언어 교환 친구랑 카페에서 만나기로 했어요.

items.text: You write a few lines about your day in Korean.
items.example: 하루에 세 줄씩 한국어로 일기를 써요.

items.text: You watch a show with no subtitles to train your ears.
items.example: 익숙한 드라마는 자막 없이 봐도 이해돼요.

sections.heading: A typical guide: studying with a drama

steps.en: use the expressions in your diary

sections.heading: Language sense: asking for help and taking compliments
paragraphs: Asking for corrections: Many Koreans won't correct your mistakes because they want to be polite. So ask them directly: “틀린 데가 있으면 고쳐 주세요.” To check if something sounds natural, ask: “이 말, 자연스러워요?”

Taking compliments: Koreans often say “한국어 잘하시네요!” even after just a few words. They are encouraging you. A common modest reply is “아니에요, 아직 많이 부족해요.” You can also say “감사합니다. 더 열심히 할게요.” Avoid answering “네, 저 잘해요.”

exercises: Write the study method from the guide that matches each sentence: ① 친구가 읽어 주는 문장을 듣고 공책에 그대로 적어요. ② 한국 사람의 목소리를 들으면서 바로 똑같이 따라 말해요. ③ 미국 친구에게 영어를 배우고, 대신 한국어를 가르쳐 줘요.

Read the notice and answer in English: [한국어 말하기 모임] 매주 목요일 저녁 7시, 3층 휴게실. 처음 오는 분은 한국어로 자기소개 세 문장을 준비해 오세요. 모임에서는 영어를 쓰지 않아요. ① What should first-time members prepare? ② Which language can't you use at the meeting?
Choose the more natural, modest reply. A Korean says: “와, 한국어 정말 잘하시네요!” (a) 아니에요, 아직 많이 부족해요. (b) 네, 맞아요. 저는 한국어를 잘해요.
Fill in the blank with the phrase you use to ask if something sounds natural: 이 말, ____?
Choose the better way to learn the set phrase “잘 부탁드립니다”: (a) 잘, 부탁, 드리다, -ㅂ니다를 하나씩 따로 외워요. (b) 덩어리로 한 번에 외워요.
answers: ① 받아쓰기 ② 따라 말하기 (섀도잉) ③ 언어 교환
